newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - DEC 10.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - DEC 10.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- President Arpad Goncz paid his first visit to privatisation agency APV Rt today.
- The new welfare minister did not ask extra funding for the health care system.
- Budapest Mayor Gabor Demszky said the capital's gas and electricity companies should set up compensation funds to help those unable to pay their bills that will be higher as of January 1.
- Hungary's parliament is debating the Hungarian-Romanian friendship treaty before approval.
- Romania's new foreign minister will probably visit Hungary this year.
